name: Rust unsafe and FFI
description: Review unsafe Rust and foreign function boundaries.
why: Names concrete pointer, ownership, layout and panic invariants to inspect.

setup.label: Manual setup
setup.detail: Install the unsafe skill and its companion rust-verification skill from the same pinned revision; preserve their sibling directory layout.

cautions: The interior-mutability reference links to the sibling rust-verification skill for Miri and loom guidance and asks for those checks before trusting new wrappers; the companion and tools require separate setup.
The guidance is a starting checklist, not a proof of soundness.

name: rust-analyzer
description: Rust language server for navigation, diagnostics and refactoring.
why: Compiler-aware code navigation helps with larger Rust projects.

setup.label: Manual setup
setup.detail: Install an editor LSP integration or use rustup component add rust-analyzer and rustup component add rust-src; editor configuration is separate.

cautions: An LSP server is not an MCP server. Some editors already bundle it; standard-library source and toolchain versions must be compatible.

name: Miri
description: Interpret Rust tests with additional undefined-behavior checks.
why: Finds certain unsafe-code defects on executed paths.

setup.label: Manual setup
setup.detail: Install the nightly Miri component with rustup +nightly component add miri, then run cargo +nightly miri test in a trusted project.

cautions: A passing run is not a soundness proof. Miri cannot execute all host operations or foreign functions and may require a matching nightly.

name: cargo-audit
description: Compare Cargo.lock dependencies against RustSec advisories.
why: Finds known vulnerable Rust dependencies in Cargo projects.

setup.label: Manual setup
setup.detail: Install with cargo install cargo-audit and run cargo audit in a trusted project; the advisory database is fetched separately.

cautions: It checks known advisories, not all vulnerabilities or reachable code. If Cargo.lock is missing it can run cargo update and Cargo may execute project code; inspect untrusted lockfiles from outside the project as upstream documents.
